intent: Record as reviewed rules three behaviors the platform already enforces and tests: account purge is all-or-nothing across owners, a lost attempt's model key is revoked before reassignment, and a timed-out Run ends its live attempt.
observable_outcome: resolve-terms and get-record return the three rules as reviewed, each citing the code that enforces it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Account purge removes each owner's workspace data and refuses to start when any owner's step is missing.
A lost attempt's model key is revoked before the next attempt is dispatched.
A Run timed out by its job or by the supervisor leaves no live attempt.
The approval that makes the records reviewed is checkable outside the package.
